# Security reporting

Report suspected vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/johanwistbacka/gitup/security/advisories/new).

Include the GitUp, WordPress and PHP versions, the required user permissions, reproduction steps and the expected impact. Use synthetic credentials and a disposable test site. Do not include a live GitHub token, customer data or a database backup.

Repository owner Johan Wistbacka handles triage, remediation and release communication. A report is checked against current code, reproduced in an isolated environment when possible, and followed by a regression test and a reviewed patch. Confirmed vulnerabilities are communicated through GitHub security advisories or release notes when a fix is available.

Use the latest stable GitUp release. Earlier releases can lack security fixes described in the changelog. This document does not promise a response time or a support lifetime.

Do not post exploit details, tokens or other sensitive information in a public issue before coordinated disclosure.
